items.title: Jonathan Taylor is active for the Colts on Sunday
items.text: Running back Jonathan Taylor may not be a member of the Colts at this time next week, but he will be in their lineup in Jacksonville on Sunday.

items.title: George Pickens is ready to go for the Cowboys
items.text: All of the inactives for Cowboys-Cardinals and the rest of Sunday's 1 p.m. ET games.

items.title: Mike Macdonald hasn't committed to Jadarian Price playing on Monday
items.text: When the Seahawks' final injury report, issued on Saturday, had both running back Zach Charbonnet and running back Jadarian Price free from any designation for Monday night's game against the Bears, it created the impression that both will play.

items.title: Eagles reportedly won't trade Saquon Barkley
items.text: At a time when some believe the Eagles are in a soft tank, their subtle effort to secure better round-by-round draft position in 2027 won't include getting an extra draft pick or two for running back Saquon Barkley.

items.title: The new allegations against Josh Jacobs could create a credibility issue
items.text: Friday's release of police records in the Josh Jacobs case brought to light allegations made by three other women against the Packers running back.

items.title: Colts will take calculated risk, if Jonathan Taylor plays today
items.text: The NFL's injury report places no obligation on teams to disclose that a player will be a healthy scratch.

items.title: Report: Raiders have "no plans" to trade Maxx Crosby (again)
items.text: The Raiders traded defensive end Maxx Crosby in March.

items.title: Breece Hall is not expected to play against Raiders
items.text: The Jets are set to play without running back Breece Hall again this Sunday.

items.title: Thank you for 25 years (get ready for 25 more)
items.text: From November 1, 2001, to November 1, 2026. And beyond.

items.title: Ben Johnson: Jeffery Simmons will play a lot, maybe not a full workload Monday night
items.text: In seven games with the Titans this season, Jeffery Simmons was on the field for 87 percent of defensive snaps and 21 percent of special teams snaps.

items.title: Josh Allen going for his 102nd win counting playoffs, more than Tom Brady's first 9 seasons
items.text: If Allen and the Bills win today, he'll surpass Brady for sole possession of the third-most wins in a quarterback's first nine seasons.

items.title: Bill Belichick and UNC nearly upset No. 1 Miami
items.text: Earlier this month, Bill Belichick and North Carolina got a signature win over previously-unbeaten Pitt.

items.title: Joe Burrow is one four-TD, no-INT game away from elite club
items.text: The 2026 Bengals have won two, lost two, and then won two.

items.title: Cowboys have a franchise-record 14 straight games with 20 or more points allowed
items.text: The Dallas Cowboys have applied to themselves the nickname of "greatest offense there is."

items.title: With 88 yards on Sunday, Derrick Henry will jump to No. 7 all-time in rushing yards
items.text: Ravens running back Derrick Henry, who turns 33 in early January, continues to get it done at a high level.

items.title: As Eagles prepare for Sunday night, questions of effort from Monday night linger
items.text: As the Eagles plunged to their fifth straight loss, questions emerged regarding effort, or lack thereof.

items.title: Jets put DT T'Vondre Sweat on IR
items.text: The Jets ruled defensive tackle T'Vondre Sweat out for Week 8 on Friday and they ruled him out for at least three more games on Saturday.

items.title: Seahawks RBs Zach Charbonnet, Jadarian Price will return Monday night
items.text: The Seahawks will have veteran running back Zach Charbonnet and rookie running back Jadarian Price in the same game for the first time on Monday.

items.title: Deion Sanders and Colorado survive in overtime for first Big 12 win of the season
items.text: It was harder than it should have been, but Colorado and coach Deion Sanders finally have their first Big 12 win of the season, beating Kansas State 27-24 in overtime to snap a five-game losing streak.

items.title: Bears rule out RB Kyle Monangai
items.text: Bears running back Kyle Monangai will miss his fourth consecutive game.

items.title: New appeals court ruling could end Sunday Ticket
items.text: NFL will eventually need to come up with a new way to provide out-of-market games.

items.title: Appeals court reverses rejection of damages award against NFL in Sunday Ticket class action
items.text: NFL undoubtedly will appeal the ruling to the U.S. Supreme Court.

items.title: After Josh Jacobs was arrested, three other women told police he had abused them, too
items.text: Police records released late on Friday show three women contacted police after Jacobs' May arrest to report similar incidents.

items.title: Josh Jacobs could be on thin ice in Green Bay
items.text: Throughout his off-field incident that resulted in a no-contest plea to misdemeanor battery, the Packers have remained steadfast in their support of running back Josh Jacobs.

items.title: NFL "will review" the new allegations against Josh Jacobs
items.text: Jacobs could be facing a lengthy suspension.

items.title: Jonathan Taylor trade talks are "active and ongoing"

items.title: Report: John Harbaugh called Amy Adams Strunk directly in an effort to land Jeffery Simmons
items.text: Harbaugh's unconventional move failed to prevent Bears from doing deal with Titans.

items.title: NFL fines Caleb Williams $23,882 for "unauthorized logo" on shoes in Week 7
items.text: NFL doubles the fine amount from Week 6; Williams has said he won't back down.

items.title: Report: NFL flexes referee Alex Moore's crew out of prime time
items.text: The NFL, for reasons still neither known nor apparent, opted not to flex the game between the 2-5 Eagles and 1-4-1 Commanders out of prime time, despite multiple other compelling Sunday afternoon games.

items.title: Of eight use of helmet infractions in Week 7, only Cam Skattebo was flagged
items.text: The fine imposed on Giants running back Cam Skattebo for illegal use of the helmet was not a rarity.
